items.title: 67259_Big Chief Moore oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Yeah, he was with Stan Kenton.

ctx.x: Vido Musso has been around with a number of orchestras and so in the St. Louis area he was a fixture on the scene or at least he would pass through a lot at that time? He came out of California, didn't he?
Yeah, he was with Stan Kenton.

It was a beautiful jam session. To hear those guys blow -- wonderful, inspiring, makes you want to blow just as well as they used to blow. We all tried to copy each other, head-cutting, you know. We called that we used to have in New Orleans, that head-cutting sessions, you know.
